title: Great tour in Spanish
text: Lucia Gonzalez Martinez was a great guide! Very knowledgeable, friendly, and was always willing to answer all questions! I recommend this tour but make sure you are aware it’s in Spanish ! I purchased it thinking it was in English but thankfully I speak Spanish too so I was able to understand. It was also much cheaper than other tours so It was a great alternative when no spots were available in the official Alhambra website.
author: Iris_G

title: Our guided tour of the...
text: Our guided tour of the Alhambra was amazing: it made it so much more meaningful to learn about and understand the history of what we were seeing.  Our guide was amazing: a true story teller and very knowledgeable.  And we were lucky enough that we ended up with a small group, for a more personalized experience and by booking late day, the site was much quieter.  All making for a wonderful experience.
